title: catenulina hedysaroides
intro: Catenulina hedysaroides, commonly known as Wild Strawberry, is a species of flowering plant in the family Gentianaceae. This plant is known for its potential health benefits, which include reducing inflammation and alleviating symptoms of fever and digestive issues, due to its antipyretic, anti-inflammatory, and carminative properties. The therapeutic actions of Catenulina hedysaroides include soothing and calming the body, as well as providing antioxidant and antimicrobial effects. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
